newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faulding says U.S. sales rise 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faulding says U.S. sales rise 23 pct.

text.p: F.H Faulding and Co Ltd's United States operations on Thursday reported a modest profit and a 23 percent rise in sales to US$22.2 million in the second quarter of 1996/97.
Faulding Inc president Richard Moldin said in a statement the company had net income of US$78,000 in the quarter compared with a net loss of US$702,000 in the year ago quarter.

For the six months to December 31, Faulding Inc recorded net sales of US$40.8 million, up from US$33.7 million on the previous year, and had net income of US$112,000 up from a net loss of US$3.6 million, he said.

"We have made steady progress since our restructuring last year and Faulding Inc now is poised for greater sales and profits because of the record number of new products that it has moving through the pipeline at the Food and Drug Administration into the marketplace," he said.
